title: Lazy Sunday Breakfast
description: A simple and delicious breakfast recipe with a twist of umami flavor.
instructions: Cut the casabe into small pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the umami over the casabe and toss to coat.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes.
While the casabe is baking, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until scrambled.
Remove the casabe from the oven and top with the scrambled eggs.
Sprinkle the flaky and Sunday ingredients over the eggs.
Return the baking sheet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
